transcript: I didn't even set a timer.  Are you kidding me?
metadata_caption: I was NOT expecting that! 🫣 I know this is a little different from what we normally do, but I really want to show my reaction to finding out if I was pregnant or not! We have been wanting to grow our family and make Ellie a big sister, so the times that I test are always really stressful for me! I have tested for a few months now, so I had an expectation of the test being negative, but in the end, you never really know until you take the test! With my health this past year and irregular cycles, we weren’t sure how possible it would be to get a positive test! I am so excited for this next adventure and all of the amazing moments that are coming soon! 🥹❤️ #kayandtayofficial #couples #relationships #pregnant #postpartum
